concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑005 is not referenced in any phase of the implementation plan; the plan fails to address the requirement that the analysis complete within 6 h on a CPU‑only runner.

Artifacts such as `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `quickstart.md`, and the contract files are listed as deliverables but are not linked to any functional requirement (FR‑001 – FR‑006) or success criterion (SC‑001 – SC‑005), constituting over‑reach beyond the specification.
Phase 6 mentions validation and contract execution but does not map to any FR or SC, leaving these activities unanchored to the specification.
